name: 2020-2c-parcial2
title: Adventure Games II: Rooms and taking objects
description: A graphic adventure engine with a Backpack, portable objects and a MarsRover-style PlayableCharacter. The student must add a Room of NxM cells in which the character moves onto free positions, place portable and non-portable StageObjects (non-portable ones can contain others) and let the character take the portable objects in front of it, including those nested inside non-portable objects, as long as the backpack has room.

design.notes: The character, portable and non-portable objects share the room's cells, and take must recursively pull portable objects out of a composite of non-portable containers without stopping at the first backpack rejection, which invites double dispatch over the StageObject hierarchy instead of isKindOf: checks.
